configuration: M3-Agent long-video QA configuration as run by the repository: memorization by memory-7b-sft (Qwen2.5-Omni-7B SFT checkpoint models/M3-Agent-Memorization, driven by m3_agent/memorization_memory_graphs.py with insightface face detection, ERes2NetV2 speaker embeddings and Gemini-1.5-pro-002 diarization/ASR as perception tools), an external multimodal graph (mmagent/videograph.py VideoGraph, pickled per video), and control by control-32b-rl (models/M3-Agent-Control served through vLLM in m3_agent/control.py, at most total_round=5 rounds, search_clip top-k=2). The GPT-4o/Gemini prompting path in mmagent/retrieve.py (answer_with_retrieval with a Gemini retrieval plan) is a baseline and was not judged.

S->M.label: reported
S->M.rationale: The memorization process takes each 30 s clip (video frames, audio, detected faces, diarized speech), has the memorization model generate episodic and semantic entries, and writes them into the graph: text nodes are added with embeddings and clip timestamps and linked by edges to the face/voice entity nodes they mention; new face/voice embeddings are added as nodes or merged into matched nodes; semantic entries that match an existing node reinforce or weaken its edges. The graph is then pickled for later use by control. This is sensed evidence delivered to Memory for admission, integration and correction.

When a memory generated by the memorization process already exists in long-term memory, the corresponding node or edge is reactivated and its weight increased"

M->A.label: reported
M->A.rationale: The control model (control-32b-rl) decides each round between [Search] and [Answer]; a [Search] query is embedded and matched against the stored episodic/semantic text nodes of the pickled graph (clip-wise or node-wise, with character-ID translation from refresh_equivalences), and the retrieved memories are appended to the conversation as 'Searched knowledge' that conditions the next generation and the final answer. Retained information therefore directly drives the content and timing (answer vs. keep searching) of the action.

A->S.label: absent
A->S.rationale: In this configuration the two processes are decoupled by a file hand-off and the control action space contains no perception-directing action. memorization_memory_graphs.py consumes only the clip directory (glob over sample['clip_path']) and writes sample['mem_path']; control.py never opens video, audio or the face/voice detectors and only reloads that pickle (control.py:117). The policy's only actions are [Search] over stored memory (an M->A retrieval, not sensing) and [Answer]; the before_clip truncation that limits retrieval comes from the benchmark annotation file, not from the agent's decisions. The complete repository at this commit therefore identifies the whole route from Action to Sensing as unimplemented, and the paper describes memorization as driven solely by the incoming stream in a parallel process.
A->S.locator: m3_agent/memorization_memory_graphs.py:69-100 (streaming_process_video takes only clip files); m3_agent/control.py:100-132 and :143-157 (before_clip read from annotations); mmagent/retrieve.py:237-275; README.md line 56 ('two parallel processes'); paper Sec. 4.3 and Algorithm 1 (action set [Search]/[Answer])

M->S.label: reported
M->S.rationale: During memorization, each newly detected face cluster and each diarized voice segment of the current clip is interpreted by matching its embedding against the face/voice nodes already retained in the graph (search_img_nodes / search_voice_nodes with img_matching_threshold 0.3 and audio_matching_threshold 0.6); the matched persistent node IDs are then used to label the faces (<face_{id}>) and voices (<voice_{id}>) in the multimodal context given to the memorization model, which describes the clip in terms of those identities. Retained priors thus guide the interpretation of the current observation, independent of any answer-time retrieval or Action decision, so this is not the M->A->S composition.

A->M.label: absent
A->M.rationale: The control loop never writes to the memory graph: it reloads the pickled graph from disk at every search round (control.py:117), applies only in-process truncation/refresh, and contains no save call; the memorization script is the sole writer (pickle.dump at memorization_memory_graphs.py:99-100). The agent's own [Search]/[Answer] outputs live only in the per-question conversation list, which is discarded when the question finishes, and the trajectories plus gpt_eval are dumped to data/results/<dataset>.jsonl purely as an evaluation output that nothing reads back. The paper's only described write path into memory is from the memorization process, and the control action set has no memory-write action, so the route from Action to Memory is unimplemented in this configuration.

record.label: not_stated
record.rationale: The service keeps no record of its own actions for later use. Within one question the control loop appends its [Search]/[Answer] turns to a transient conversation (control.py:194) and the prompt asks for a query different from previous ones (control.py:86), but that context is dropped when the question ends; the per-question trajectories with gpt_eval are written to data/results/<dataset>.jsonl only as a benchmark output for the authors (control.py:201-211). The memory graph stores observations, never the agent's decisions.

outcome.label: not_stated
outcome.rationale: The only outcome signal is GPT-4o's yes/no judgment of the final answer against the annotated ground truth, computed by the evaluation script (eval_answer, control.py:57-77, :203) and stored in the results file as benchmark accuracy; the service does not obtain or retain any reply, rating, correction or state change about its actions. The binary gpt4o_evaluator reward in Sec. 4.4 is the authors' offline DAPO training signal, not an outcome gathered by the deployed configuration.
outcome.quote: Paper Sec. 4.4 (UNVERIFIED, via fetch tool): "Ri={1, if gpt4o_evaluator(q,a,yi)=True; 0, otherwise}"

attribution.label: not_stated
attribution.rationale: No in-service mechanism links an outcome to the decision it concerns to check or correct assistance; gpt_eval is only attached to each question record for aggregate scoring (control.py:203-206). Reward-to-trajectory advantage computation exists only inside the authors' offline DAPO training (paper Sec. 4.4), which is offline scoring by the authors and does not count.

revision.label: not_stated
revision.rationale: Nothing in the deployed configuration changes its own mechanism: the memorization checkpoint (processing_config 'ckpt' models/M3-Agent-Memorization, loaded in chat_qwen.py:39-47) and the control checkpoint (control.py:32, :141) are fixed, and the prompts are static strings (control.py:79-89, mmagent/prompts.py). Growth of the memory graph (episodic/semantic nodes, face/voice embeddings, edge weights) is content consumed by a fixed mechanism, not a rule or parameter change. The SFT of memory-7b-sft and the DAPO training of control-32b-rl (paper Sec. 4.4) are developer-run offline training before deployment; the fetch tool found no sentence about updating models, prompts or policies after deployment or at test time.

later_use.label: not_stated
later_use.rationale: Because the service makes no revision of its own mechanism, there is no reported run under a service-revised mechanism; the evaluations in Sec. 5 run the developer-trained checkpoints, which is not later use of a self-made revision.

notes: Judged the repository's long-video QA pipeline (memorization_memory_graphs.py -> pickled VideoGraph -> control.py with M3-Agent-Control via vLLM, H=5 rounds, k=2), i.e. memory-7b-sft plus control-32b-rl with the external multimodal graph. Perception tools in this configuration also call Gemini-1.5-pro-002 for diarization/ASR and text-embedding-3-large for node embeddings (mmagent/voice_processing.py, mmagent/utils/chat_api.py). Code was read in full at commit 0e3e419; README and code quotes are verbatim. Shell access to download the arXiv HTML was denied, so every paper quote came through a paraphrasing fetch tool and is labelled UNVERIFIED; the page carried the date October 9, 2025, matching arXiv v4. Channel labels 'absent' for A->S and A->M rest on the complete implementation showing no such path (file hand-off between the two processes, graph reloaded read-only per round, action set limited to [Search]/[Answer]); within-episode conversation context was not treated as Memory because it is not retained across interactions.
